title: Offer Win Calibration + 72h Quick-Onboard Path
content:
Purpose:
This lightweight playbook helps hiring managers and recruiters decide the right negotiation posture, estimate offer-acceptance probability, and execute a 72-hour quick-onboard path for high-priority hires (ICs and senior ICs). The goal is to increase offer velocity and time-to-impact without sacrificing consistency or equitable practices.

Scope and when to use:
- Use for candidates where business impact is time-sensitive (critical features, short runway hires, replacements with immediate knowledge gaps).
- Not intended for executive hires or large enterprise negotiations (use enterprise offer playbook).
- Triage stage triggers: hiring manager flags role as "time-critical" OR candidate is in late-stage with competing offers OR role has <3 weeks coverage risk.

Definitions (quick):
- Offer Win Probability (OWP): a pragmatic score (0-100) estimating likelihood candidate will accept given current offer posture and signals.
- Negotiation Tier: A/B/C tiers for concessions we can make without extra approvals.

OWP Framework (one-pager):
1) Inputs (each scored 0-10, sum /60 -> normalized):
   - Candidate enthusiasm signals (timing, explicit language, follow-up cadence)
   - Competing offer intensity (none / soft / multiple-strong)
   - Current offer competitiveness (base + equity + bonus vs market reference)
   - Role fit & org pull (hiring manager reputation, team mission clarity)
   - Logistical barriers (visa, relocation, notice period)
   - Candidate constraints (counteroffer likelihood, personal factors)
2) Quick mapping: OWP > 75 -> green (low risk); 50-75 -> amber (negotiate smart); <50 -> red (re-consider or escalate).
3) Action by band: green = proceed with standard offers + 24h follow-up; amber = prepare negotiation cushion (see tiers); red = escalate to hiring committee and consider stronger incentives or pause.

Negotiation Tiers (pre-approved concessions):
- Tier A (auto): increase base up to +7% of initial offer; accelerate start date; clarify bonus payout timing; one-time signing stipend up to $5k.
- Tier B (manager approval): additional +8–15% base or small equity top-up (one-time RSU tranche), relocation support up to $12k, limited sign-on cash up to $15k.
- Tier C (People Ops + Finance approval): total comp reshaping, multi-year equity re‑structure, flexible bonus guarantees, extended relocation or visa support.

Equity/comp sanity checks:
- Reference bands in linked spreadsheet before any adjustment.
- For senior ICs use midpoint+benchmarks; for levels L3-L4 keep concession conservative.

Communication playbook (recruiter + manager script snippets):
- Day 0 (offer extended): email template + 4 bullet highlights (impact, manager intro, reasons we chose them). Ask for signal of timing by EOD next business day.
- Day 1 (if no response): recruiter follow-up + personal note from hiring manager emphasizing team mission and logistical details.
- Day 2 (if amber/red): recruiter asks for a short call to understand constraints; manager preps talking points based on negotiation tier.
- Day 3 (72h): final follow-up with explicit close window; if candidate requests more time and OWP high, extend once for up to 7 days with written rationale.

72-Hour Quick-Onboard Path (checklist for People Ops + Manager):
- Before acceptance (prep):
  - Manager: create 72h landing pad: first-week deliverable, key contacts, repo access list.
  - IT: pre-approve laptop spec and shipping; manager to confirm software access list with SRE.
  - People Ops: prepare offer letter, NDAs, equity paperwork, first-paycheck timeline.
  - Mobility/Security: if relocation, start customs and vendor kick-off.

- On acceptance (Day 0-1):
  - Send confirmation + onboarding calendar invite (first 2 weeks): team syncs, product deep-dive, 1:1 with manager.
  - IT: ship laptop same business day (or pick-up window).
  - Access: company email, single sign-on, Slack, GitHub (roster queue), internal docs provisioning.
  - Buddy: assign onboarding buddy and set 30/60/90 expectations.

- Day 1-3 (first 72h):
  - Day 1: manager-led orientation + deliverable kickoff.
  - Day 2: cross-team intro meetings (product, infra, security) + short tech ramp session with buddy.
  - Day 3: mini-practical onboarding task assigned and reviewed (code review or simple bug fix) to validate access and context.

- Pre-90-day follow-ups (calendar items to create immediately):
  - 2-week check-in (manager + buddy)
  - 30-day impact review with concrete objectives
  - 60-day alignment sync (product + manager)
  - 90-day calibration (people ops + manager to evaluate role fit and potential adjustments)

Interview rubric tie-ins (minimum required during quick hires):
- All interviewers must complete standard rubric within 48h. Key axes: technical competence, ownership, communication, bias signals. Quick-hire hires require one senior cross-functional interviewer to validate team fit.
- Mandatory evidence capture: link to GitHub PR or take-home snippet if relevant; short behavioral note describing past ownership example.

Risk controls & fairness guardrails:
- Every concession must be logged in the offer tracker with rationale and approver initials.
- Ensure equity concessions apply consistently across similar levels; People Ops will review weekly for anomalies.
- If role is underrepresented candidate flag, route final approvals through inclusion partner for double-check.

Operational templates (copy-edit in Drive):
- Offer email template (consumer-friendly)
